facts.text: It appeared 24 hours after I ate raw shiitake mushrooms.
facts.value: 24 hours after eating raw shiitake mushrooms

facts.text: It's red to purplish streaks in lines, like whip marks.
It's on both arms and both legs, and it runs together over my chest and scalp.
I also have separate little pus spots on my body and in my skin folds.
Ten days ago I ate partially cooked shiitake mushrooms.
Six days after that, I ate raw shiitake mushrooms.
I don't have any allergic conditions like eczema, asthma or hay fever.
I don't have any long-term illnesses.
I haven't taken any medicines recently.

findings.name: skin examination
findings.result: Erythematous to violaceous linear streaks in a flagellate pattern, symmetric over the arms and legs, coalescing over the chest and scalp; discrete pustules on the trunk and in intertriginous areas.

findings.name: skin biopsy
findings.result: Follicular sterile pustules with a mild mixed perivascular inflammatory infiltrate.
